R/ [SECVRITAS REI PVBLI]CAE ; D/ [...] S P F AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian. AD367-375, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [SECVRITAS REI PVBLI]CAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left. Mint is Lyon. See LRBC p.52, no.354-357. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...] S P F AVG. Reverse fields and exergue reads: OF above [...]/I above R//LVGP. Die axis is 6 o'clock,…
